rules.name: The Great Workshops
rules.description:
Skryre armies purchase Workshop Projects before battle by spending Workshop Tokens. **Workshop Tokens**
*When mustering your army, receive Workshop Tokens based on battle size.* | INCURSION | STRIKE FORCE | ONSLAUGHT | |---|---|---| | 1,000 points: 6 Tokens | 2,000 points: 12 Tokens | 3,000 points: 18 Tokens | **Purchase Projects**
During Muster Armies, spend Workshop Tokens to purchase Workshop Projects from the following pages. **Assign Projects**
When a Workshop Project is assigned to a unit, record it on your Army Roster. That unit gains the SKRYRE keyword if it does not already have it. **Project Limit**
A unit can have no more than 2 Workshop Projects. Projects not assigned to a unit, such as Hidden Workshop and Doomsphere, do not count toward a unit's Project limit. **Unique Designs**
Each named Workshop Project can be purchased only once per army. **Not Enhancements**
Workshop Projects are not Enhancements. **Unused Tokens**
Unspent Workshop Tokens are lost when the battle begins.

rules.name: Make-Make New Ones!
rules.description: Your They Just Keep Coming! Vermin Ability can also target destroyed non-CHARACTER MOULDER BEAST units. When a new MOULDER BEAST unit is created this way, you can Flesh-Sculpt it before placing it in the Under-Empire. That new unit gains the MUTATED keyword.

rules.name: Monstrous Creations
rules.description: Your They Just Keep Coming! Vermin Ability can also target destroyed non-CHARACTER MOULDER MONSTER units. When it does, roll the Vermin cost normally (adding any surcharge first), then double the final rolled cost. If Thirteen for the Horned Rat is used instead, Sacrifice exactly 26 eligible friendly SKAVEN models instead of 13. Flesh-Sculpting costs must still be paid using Vermin. The created MONSTER can be placed in and emerge from the Under-Empire despite being a MONSTER. This exception applies only to the unit created by They Just Keep Coming! and does not otherwise allow that MONSTER to enter the Under-Empire.

rules.name: Remade Clanrats
rules.description: When They Just Keep Coming! creates a new CLANRATS unit, you can Flesh-Sculpt that unit before placing it in the Under-Empire. That unit gains the MOULDER and MUTATED keywords, can receive a maximum of one Flesh-Sculpting alteration, and cannot select Bloated Mass or Withered Frame.

rules.name: Flesh-Sculpting
rules.description: When Make-Make New Ones! creates an eligible unit, select Flesh-Sculpting alterations for it. MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER units can receive a maximum of 3 alterations; CLANRATS can receive a maximum of 1. Each characteristic can only be altered once.

rules.name: Moulder Character Ability
rules.description:
*Every MOULDER CHARACTER model from your army has this ability.* **Fresh Meat-Meat!:**
At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly MOULDER BEAST, MOULDER MONSTER or CLANRATS unit within 6" of this model, then select one other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within 3" of this model. You can Sacrifice up to 3 models from that SKAVEN INFANTRY unit. If the first selected unit is a CLANRATS unit, for each model Sacrificed, return one destroyed Clanrat model to that unit, not exceeding its Starting Strength. Otherwise, for each model Sacrificed, one model in the first selected unit regains 1 lost wound. Each eligible unit can only be selected as the first selected unit for this ability once per phase.

rules.name: The Master Moulder's Ledger
rules.description:
*Each alteration changes one characteristic of the Flesh-Sculpted unit. Positive costs must be paid in Vermin; negative costs reduce the total.* | DESIRED GROWTH | EFFECT | VERMIN | |---|---|---| | Lengthened Legs | Add 2" to Move. | +1 | | Thickened Hide | Add 1 to Toughness. | +2 | | Chitinous Plates | Improve Save by 1. | +2 | | Bloated Mass | Add 1 to Wounds. | +1 | | Grasping Limbs | Add 1 to Objective Control. | +1 | | RUINOUS DEFECT | EFFECT | VERMIN | |---|---|---| | Stunted Legs | Subtract 2" from Move. | -1 | | Soft Flesh | Subtract 1 from Toughness. | -2 | | Exposed Organs | Worsen Save by 1. | -2 | | Withered Frame | Subtract 1 from Wounds. | -1 | | Uncontrollable | Subtract 1 from Objective Control. | -1 | | DESIRED GROWTH | EFFECT | VERMIN | |---|---|---| | Predatory Reflexes | Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. | +2 | | Overgrown Musculature | Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. | +1 | | Too Many Limbs | Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. Weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS] are not affected. | +2 | | RUINOUS DEFECT | EFFECT | VERMIN | |---|---|---| | Sluggish Reflexes | Worsen the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. | -2 | | Atrophied Musculature | Subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit. | -1 | | Missing Limbs | Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, to a minimum of 1. Weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS] are not affected. | -2 | **Cost & Limits**
After selecting alterations, total their Vermin modifiers. If the total is positive, spend that many additional Vermin. If the total is 0 or less, no additional Vermin are spent. Flesh-Sculpting can never generate Vermin. Flesh-Sculpting costs cannot be paid using Thirteen for the Horned Rat. Move, Toughness, Wounds and Objective Control cannot be reduced below 1. Save cannot be improved beyond 3+. Melee Weapon Skill cannot be improved beyond 3+. Melee Attacks cannot be reduced below 1. **Mutated - Unstable Mutation**
A unit created using Make-Make New Ones! gains the MUTATED keyword and this ability. This unit has Deadly Demise D6. If it already had a Deadly Demise ability, replace it with Deadly Demise D6. Each time this unit's Deadly Demise ability activates, after resolving that ability, gain D6 Vermin.

rules.name: Secret Schemes
rules.description:
​

**Choose**
After both players have deployed their armies, secretly select 4 different Schemes from the Hidden Ledger and record them. **Reveal**
At the start of your Command phase, you can reveal one unrevealed Scheme. Once revealed, it remains active until it is completed or until the battle ends. Multiple Schemes can be active at the same time. **Complete**
Each Scheme can only be completed once. You can complete a maximum of 4 Schemes during the battle. When a Scheme is completed, resolve its Payment immediately. | SELECT | REVEAL | COMPLETE | |---|---|---| | 4 Schemes | 1 per Command phase | Maximum 4 | **Black Contracts**
At the start of the first battle round, before any Scout moves are made, select up to 3 CLANRATS units from your army. Those units gain the ESHIN keyword and the following ability until the end of the battle. **Paid Informants:**
This unit has Scouts 6".

rules.name: The Hidden Ledger
rules.description:
​

**Kill-Kill the Head**
**REVEAL:** Select one enemy CHARACTER model. **COMPLETION:**
That model is destroyed by an ESHIN unit. **PAYMENT:**
Gain D3+1 Vermin and 1CP. **Burn-Burn Their Toys**
**REVEAL:** Select one enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit. **COMPLETION:**
An ESHIN unit causes that unit to become Below Half-strength or destroys it. **PAYMENT:**
Gain D3+1 Vermin. Until the end of the battle, each time an ESHIN model makes an attack that targets an enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll. **Steal-Steal the Secrets**
**REVEAL:** Select one objective in No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone. **COMPLETION:**
At the end of your turn, you control that objective and one or more ESHIN INFANTRY units are within range of it. **PAYMENT:**
Gain D3+1 Vermin. One ESHIN unit within range of that objective can immediately enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Gnawhole. **Cut-Cut the Supply**
**REVEAL:** Select one enemy non-CHARACTER unit. **COMPLETION:**
An ESHIN unit causes that enemy unit to lose one or more wounds during your Shooting phase or the Fight phase. **PAYMENT:**
Gain D3 Vermin. Until the start of your next Command phase, subtract 2" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic, it cannot make advance moves, and it cannot be removed from the battlefield and set up again by an ability. **Nothing-Nothing Was Here**
**REVEAL:** Select one ESHIN unit. **COMPLETION:**
That unit ends your turn wholly within your opponent's deployment zone and is not engaged. **PAYMENT:**
That unit can immediately enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Gnawhole. Gain D3 Vermin. **Silence the Witnesses**
**REVEAL:** Select one enemy INFANTRY unit. **COMPLETION:**
That unit is destroyed by one or more ESHIN units. **PAYMENT:**
Gain D3 Vermin. Select one ESHIN INFANTRY unit from your army that made one or more attacks against that enemy unit during the phase in which it was destroyed. That unit can immediately make a normal move of up to 6". Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit cannot be selected as the target of a ranged attack unless the attacking model is within 6". **Sabotage-Sabotage!**
**REVEAL:** Select one objective in No Man's Land or your opponent's deployment zone. **COMPLETION:**
At the end of your turn, you control that objective, one or more ESHIN INFANTRY units are within range of it, and at least one such unit is not engaged. **PAYMENT:**
Gain D3 Vermin. That objective becomes Sabotaged until the start of your next Command phase. While Sabotaged, enemy models within range of it have an Objective Control characteristic of 0, and each time an enemy unit ends a normal, advance, fall-back or charge move within range of it, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Brewing the Plague
rules.description: At the start of your Command phase, you can brew one Plague. Select one Plague from the Plague Catalogue and pay its listed Vermin cost. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Plague is active and modifies the Pestilence auras of friendly PESTILENS units. You cannot brew the same Plague in consecutive battle rounds.

rules.name: Spread-Spread the Plague!
rules.description: Each time an enemy unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks made by a PESTILENS unit, after the attacking unit has finished making those attacks, if that enemy unit lost one or more wounds as a result, roll one D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit becomes INFECTED until the start of your next Command phase. Each enemy unit can only be tested for Infection once per phase.

rules.name: Infected
rules.description: An INFECTED unit is treated as though it were within range of a friendly Pestilence aura for the purposes of the currently brewed Plague, regardless of its actual distance from friendly PESTILENS units. Being INFECTED does not by itself apply the normal Pestilence ability unless another rule states otherwise.

rules.name: Virulent Proximity
rules.description: At the start of each Fight phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within range of one or more friendly Pestilence auras. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. A unit can only be affected by Virulent Proximity once per Fight phase.

rules.name: Filth-Filth Carriers
rules.description:
At the start of the first battle round, before any Scout moves are made, select up to 3 CLANRATS units from your army. Those units gain the PESTILENS keyword and the following ability until the end of the battle. **Plague Carrier:**
This unit has a 3" Pestilence aura. That aura carries the currently brewed Plague, but this unit does not gain the normal Pestilence ability. For the purposes of the currently brewed Plague and Virulent Proximity, this unit is also treated as though it were an enemy unit within range of a friendly Pestilence aura.

rules.name: The Plague Catalogue
rules.description:
*Brew one Plague at the start of your Command phase by paying its Vermin cost. "Pestilence range" means within range of a friendly Pestilence aura.* **The Weeping Pox [2 Vermin]**
*Lesser Contagion* While an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1, and battle-shock rolls taken for that unit cannot be re-rolled. **The Red Death [3 Vermin]**
*Virulent Brew* Each time a model in a PESTILENS unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit within Pestilence range, an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ scores a critical wound. **The Crawling Ague [3 Vermin]**
*Virulent Brew* Enemy units within Pestilence range subtract 2" from their Move characteristic, subtract 2 from advance rolls and subtract 2 from charge rolls. Multiple instances do not stack. **The Black Rot [4 Vermin]**
*Grand Plague* Each time an enemy unit ends a normal, advance, fall-back or charge move while within Pestilence range, roll one D6. On a 4+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. A unit can only suffer these mortal wounds once per phase. **The Withering Sickness [4 Vermin]**
*Grand Plague* While an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of its melee weapons. If that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, also worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1. **Nurglitch's Gift [5 Vermin]**
*Master's Concoction* When this Plague is brewed, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within Pestilence range. On a 2+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an enemy unit is within Pestilence range, subtract 1 from its Toughness characteristic, it cannot regain lost wounds, and destroyed models cannot be returned to that unit.

rules.name: Clawpacks
rules.description: During the Declare Battle Formations step, you can organize eligible units into Clawpacks. Each Clawpack consists of one VERMINUS CHARACTER unit and up to 3 CLANRATS and/or STORMVERMIN units. Each unit can belong to only one Clawpack. A CHARACTER does not need to Lead a unit in its Clawpack.

rules.name: Under Command
rules.description: While a CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit is within 8" of its Clawpack's CHARACTER unit, that unit is UNDER COMMAND.

rules.name: Yes-Yes, Warlord!
rules.description: At the start of your Command phase, each VERMINUS CHARACTER commanding a Clawpack can issue one Warlord Command to one UNDER COMMAND unit from its Clawpack. That Command lasts until the start of your next Command phase. A unit can normally only be affected by one Warlord Command at a time.

rules.name: Warlord Commands
rules.description:
​

**Kill-Kill Them!**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If this unit contains 10 or more models, also re-roll a Wound roll of 1. **Move-Move, Cowards!**
Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 2 to advance rolls made for it. **Hold-Hold or Die!**
Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit. While this unit contains 10 or more models, it can re-roll battle-shock rolls. **Stab-Stab from Behind!**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit that is also engaged with another friendly SKAVEN unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. **Shields Up-Up!**
Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit, that model has the Benefit of Cover. If this unit already has the Benefit of Cover, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 instead.

rules.name: Clawpack Benefits
rules.description:
​

**Ranks Upon Ranks**
While a CLANRATS unit is UNDER COMMAND and contains 10 or more models, improve its Leadership characteristic by 1 and add 1 to Hit rolls for melee attacks made by models in that unit. While it contains 20 or more models, also add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of its models. **Black-Furred Elite**
While a STORMVERMIN unit is UNDER COMMAND, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit that is engaged with one or more friendly CLANRATS units, add 1 to the Wound roll. **No Run-Run! Fight-Fight!**
Once per battle round, when an UNDER COMMAND CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit fails a battle-shock roll, its Clawpack CHARACTER can enforce discipline if it is within 8". If it does, Sacrifice D3 models from that unit. That battle-shock roll is then treated as having been passed.

rules.name: The First Breach
rules.description: Units from your army in the Under-Empire can emerge during the first battle round, even if the mission does not allow Strategic Reserves to arrive then. Each must still make its Passage roll and follow the normal rules for emerging.

rules.name: Endless Passages
rules.description: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Passage roll.

rules.name: Surging from Below
rules.description: Each time a unit from your army emerges, until the end of the turn: add 1 to the Hit roll for ranged attacks made by models in that unit; melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LANCE]; and that unit counts as having Remained Stationary.

rules.name: Masters of the Under-Empire
rules.description:
​

**Muster Below:**
When you declare battle formations, any number of SKAVEN units from your army that could be placed into Strategic Reserves can be placed into the Under-Empire, ignoring the normal limits on the number of units and points that can start the battle in Strategic Reserves. **No Reserve Deadline:**
Units in the Under-Empire are not destroyed for failing to arrive by the end of the third battle round. They can remain below until the battle ends.

rules.name: Daemonic Conduits
rules.description:
Each time a friendly SKAVEN non-DAEMON PSYKER uses a spell, before making the psychic roll, it can select one visible friendly SKAVEN DAEMON unit within 13" as its conduit. If it does:

- Measure that spell's range and visibility from either the PSYKER or the conduit.
- If that psychic roll has an unmodified 1, the PSYKER's unit does not become battle-shocked, does not resolve Cornered Rats and does not suffer mortal wounds. Instead, the conduit suffers D3 mortal wounds, or D6 mortal wounds if the spell was Overcast.

Each SKAVEN DAEMON unit can be selected as a conduit once per turn.

| CASTER | CONDUIT | BENEFIT |
|---|---|---|
| SKAVEN non-DAEMON PSYKER | SKAVEN DAEMON within 13" | Range and visibility from either point; the conduit takes the backlash |

rules.name: The Thirteenth Toll
rules.description: Each time a spell used through a Daemonic Conduit is Overcast and both dice show the same result (other than a double 1), until your next Command phase, add 1 to Hit rolls made for that conduit.

rules.name: Keeping Plunder
rules.description: Each SKURVY unit begins the battle with 0 Plunder. Record each unit's Plunder separately. When a unit is destroyed, its Plunder is lost.

rules.name: Spoils of Battle
rules.description: Each time a SKURVY unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, it gains 1 Plunder.

rules.name: Plundering Objectives
rules.description: In your Movement phase, just after a SKURVY unit from your army ends a normal move, if it is not battle-shocked, it can Plunder one objective within range that has not been Plundered by your army this turn. If it does, that unit gains 3 Plunder and cannot declare a charge this turn.

rules.name: Spending Plunder
rules.description: At the end of your Command phase, each SKURVY unit from your army that is on the battlefield and is not battle-shocked can purchase one option from the Plunder Ledger. Spend the listed amount of that unit's Plunder. Unless otherwise stated, that option lasts until the start of your next Command phase. A unit can have no more than two different Plunder options active at the same time.

rules.name: Black-Flag Clanrats
rules.description:
CLANRATS units from your army gain the SKURVY keyword and the following ability. **Claim-Claim the Prize!:**
At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is within range of an objective you control, that objective remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

rules.name: Black-Flag Mercenaries
rules.description: When mustering your army, you can include units from Index: Black-Flag. Their combined points value cannot exceed half of your army's points limit. Each unit included this way gains the SKURVY keyword.

rules.name: The Plunder Ledger
rules.description:
​

**Quick-Quick Loot [1 Plunder]**
**Stolen Ammo:** Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [IGNORES COVER]. **Extra-Extra Dakka!:**
Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. **Grav-Hooks and Boosters:**
Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it made an advance move. **Prized Spoils [2 Plunder]**
**Shiny-Shiny Shields!:** Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If they already have an invulnerable save, improve it by 1, to a maximum of 4+. **Targeting Gubbins:**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1, to a maximum of 2+. **Stolen Combat Drugs:**
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, excluding weapons with [EXTRA ATTACKS]. Add 1 to advance and charge rolls made for this unit. **The Good-Good Stuff [3 Plunder]**
**Warp-Charged Munitions:** Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. Those weapons have [WARPSTONE]. **The Really Good Stuff:**
Select two different 1-Plunder options. This unit gains both. **The Captain's Share [4 Plunder]**
**Aeldari Grav-Drives:** Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance or fall-back move.

rules.name: Rise-Rise Above Them!
rules.description:
Every friendly STORMVERMIN unit has a Supremacy Rank and begins the battle at Rank 1. Each time a friendly STORMVERMIN unit destroys one or more enemy units in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after that unit has finished making its attacks, increase its Supremacy Rank by 1, to a maximum of 3. Each time a friendly STORMVERMIN unit fails a battle-shock roll, reduce its Supremacy Rank by 1, to a minimum of 0. Supremacy Rank benefits are cumulative.

| RANK | NAME | BENEFIT |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Black-Furred Elite | Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit. |
| 2 | Best-Best Warriors | Add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by models in this unit. |
| 3 | Lords of the Lesser Rats | Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. This unit can re-roll battle-shock rolls. |

rules.name: The Horned Rat Whispers
rules.description:
| GENERATE | USE | COST |
|---|---|---|
| 6D6 per battle round | Replace 1 die of an eligible roll | D3 mortal wounds to the Grey Seer's unit |

rules.name: Prophecy Dice
rules.description: At the start of each battle round, roll 6D6 and set them aside. These are your Prophecy dice for that battle round. At the end of the battle round, discard all unused Prophecy dice.

rules.name: Foretell
rules.description:
Each time one of the following rolls is made, after rolling but before resolving it, you can replace one of its dice with one unused Prophecy die. That Prophecy die is expended, and its value is treated as unmodified for all rules purposes.

- A psychic roll made for a friendly GREY SEER model.
- A battle-shock roll, charge roll or Passage roll made for a friendly SKAVEN unit within 13" of a friendly GREY SEER model.

After that roll has been resolved, that GREY SEER model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. For a roll made for another unit, the closest friendly GREY SEER model's unit suffers them.

rules.name: Foreseen Glory
rules.description: If a Prophecy die showing a 6 replaces the die of a GREY SEER model's psychic roll, and that spell is not being Overcast, also resolve that spell's OVERCAST effect. This is not Overcasting.

rules.name: Twist-Twist Fate!
rules.description: Before using a Prophecy die, you can spend 1 Vermin. If you do, increase or decrease that Prophecy die by 1, to a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 6. Each Prophecy die can only be modified in this way once.

rules.name: Drive the Engines Hard
rules.description: Add 2 to advance rolls made for friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE units. Friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE units are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they made an advance move.

rules.name: Engine Strain
rules.description: At the end of your Shooting phase, for each friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE unit that made an advance move this turn and was selected to shoot this phase, roll one D6. On a 1-2, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Clan Allegiance
rules.description: For the purposes of this Detachment, the following are Clan keywords: VERMINUS, SKRYRE, MOULDER, ESHIN, PESTILENS and SKURVY. If a unit has more than one Clan keyword, when mustering your army select one of those keywords to be that unit's Clan Allegiance for the battle. Otherwise, a unit's Clan Allegiance is its Clan keyword.

rules.name: Work-Work Together! For Now...
rules.description: Each time a friendly unit with a Clan Allegiance is selected to shoot or fight, select one enemy unit as the target of its attacks. If that enemy unit has already lost one or more wounds during that phase as a result of attacks made by a friendly unit with a different Clan Allegiance, add 1 to Hit rolls made by the attacking unit against that enemy unit until the end of the phase. A Clan Allegiance cannot enable this benefit for another unit with the same Clan Allegiance.

rules.name: Mine-Mine Was the Plan!
rules.description: Once per phase, when a friendly unit destroys an enemy unit while benefiting from Work-Work Together! For Now..., gain 1 Vermin.

rules.description: Each Enhancement here is given to a SKURVY CHARACTER model from Index: Black-Flag. Record which model carries it on your roster.

rules.name: Paid Informants
rules.description: This unit gains the ESHIN keyword and has Scouts 6".

characteristics.name: Description

Set its remaining wounds to 5. For the rest of the battle, use the Thanquol profile shown above. It keeps its Psyker Level, the spells it knows, Supreme Grey Seer, Warpstone Snuff, Failures! Fools!, Warp bolts and Staff of the Horned Rat, and loses Warpfire projectors and Crushing fists. This ability cannot be used again.

rules.name: Chief-Chief Engineer
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

When mustering your army, select one Workshop Project purchased for your army. Reduce its Workshop Token cost by 2, to a minimum of 1. A Grand Project cannot be selected.

rules.name: Warpstone Heart-Condenser
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

Each time the bearer is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase add 2 to the Strength characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of ranged weapons equipped by the bearer; those weapons also have [HAZARDOUS]. If one or more hazard rolls are failed for the bearer that phase, each failed roll inflicts one additional mortal wound.

rules.name: Quick-Quick Escape Harness
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, just after an enemy unit has finished making attacks that targeted the bearer's unit, if the bearer remains on the battlefield and is not engaged, the bearer's unit can make a normal move of up to 6". It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT, enter the Under-Empire, or end that move within Engagement Range.

rules.name: Spare Rats, Spare Parts
rules.description:
SKRYRE CHARACTER model only.

In your Command phase, select one friendly SKRYRE VEHICLE, WEAPON TEAM or STORMFIENDS unit within 6" of the bearer. One model in that unit regains D3 lost wounds. Alternatively, select one friendly SKAVEN BATTLELINE unit within 3" of the bearer and Sacrifice D3 models from that unit. If you do, the repaired model regains 3 lost wounds instead.

rules.name: Tested-Tested! Mostly Safe!
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - non-CHARACTER SKRYRE unit only; up to three units can have this Enhancement.

Once per phase, you can re-roll one hazard roll taken for this unit. In addition, each time a Workshop Project causes this unit to suffer mortal wounds, reduce the total number of mortal wounds suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

rules.name: Master-Breeder Supreme
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, when you Flesh-Sculpt a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER using Make-Make New Ones!, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can declare that unit the bearer's masterpiece. It can receive up to 4 alterations instead of 3, and reduce its final additional Vermin cost by 2, to a minimum of 0. Only one masterpiece can be created per battle.

rules.name: Needle of the Great Stitcher
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

When the bearer uses Fresh Meat-Meat!: if the target is CLANRATS, each model Sacrificed returns 2 destroyed Clanrat models instead of 1; if the target is a MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER, each model Sacrificed restores 2 lost wounds instead of 1. Alternatively, if exactly 3 models are Sacrificed, you can return one destroyed non-CHARACTER model to a MOULDER BEAST unit with D3 wounds remaining. This alternative cannot return a MONSTER model.

rules.name: Prime-Specimen Collector
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle round, when an enemy CHARACTER, BEAST or MONSTER model is destroyed by the bearer's unit, gain D3 Vermin. If the destroyed model was a MONSTER, gain D3+1 Vermin instead.

rules.name: Warpstone Pain-Goad
rules.description:
MOULDER CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle round, at the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly MOULDER BEAST or MOULDER MONSTER unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to charge rolls made for that unit and it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move. After it completes a charge move, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Master of a Thousand Schemes
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Select one additional Scheme at the start of the battle. Once per battle, when you reveal a Scheme, you can discard it and replace it with one different Scheme you did not originally select; reveal the replacement immediately. This does not increase the maximum number of Schemes you can complete.

rules.name: Master of Escape Routes
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, at the end of any phase, if the bearer's unit is not engaged, it can enter the Under-Empire without requiring a Gnawhole. When that unit next emerges, it does not use that Gnawhole's once-per-turn use.

rules.name: Cloak of Shadows
rules.description:
ESHIN CHARACTER model only.

Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. Once per battle, when the bearer is selected as the target of one or more attacks, until the end of the phase, enemy models cannot select the bearer as the target of an attack unless they are within 6" of it.

rules.name: Arch-Plaguebrewer
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, when you brew a Plague, the bearer can concoct a Grand Concoction. If it does, brew two different Plagues instead of one and pay both Vermin costs separately. Both remain active until the start of your next Command phase. This does not allow the same Plague to be brewed in consecutive battle rounds.

rules.name: Censer of Thirteen Poxes
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Add 3" to the range of Pestilence aura abilities of the bearer's unit, to a maximum of 8". Each time an enemy unit damaged by attacks made by the bearer's unit is tested for Infection, add 1 to that roll.

rules.name: Tome of Foul Revelations
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle round, the first time an enemy unit within 8" of the bearer becomes INFECTED, gain 1 Vermin. If that unit is a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE, gain D3 Vermin instead.

rules.name: Vial of the Thirteenth Plague
rules.description:
PESTILENS CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, at the start of any phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and becomes INFECTED; no Infection roll is required. If it was already INFECTED, it instead suffers D3+2 mortal wounds and remains INFECTED.

rules.name: Filth-Slicked Weapons
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - non-CHARACTER PESTILENS unit only; up to three units can have this Enhancement.

Each time an enemy unit loses one or more wounds as a result of attacks made by this unit, add 1 to the roll to determine whether that enemy unit becomes INFECTED.

rules.name: Great-Great Warlord
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

The bearer can issue two Warlord Commands in your Command phase instead of one. Those Commands must be issued to different units from the bearer's Clawpack.

rules.name: Whip of Domination
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

Increase the range at which units from the bearer's Clawpack are UNDER COMMAND from 8" to 13". Each time the bearer uses No Run-Run! Fight-Fight!, Sacrifice 1 model instead of D3.

rules.name: Trophy-Rack of the Conqueror
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit, until the start of your next Command phase, friendly UNDER COMMAND units from the bearer's Clawpack can re-roll battle-shock rolls and add 1 to charge rolls. If the destroyed enemy unit was a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE, also gain 1 Vermin.

rules.name: Best-Best Killer
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1, to a maximum of 2+. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack against a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Red-Toothed Veterans
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - CLANRATS or STORMVERMIN unit only; up to three units can have this Enhancement.

While this unit is UNDER COMMAND, it can be affected by two different Warlord Commands simultaneously. Both Commands must have been issued by its own Clawpack CHARACTER.

rules.name: Map of Thirteen Thousand Tunnels
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not engaged and is wholly within 6" of an unused friendly Gnawhole, you can place that unit into the Under-Empire. That Gnawhole is used.

rules.name: Gnawhole Architect
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, create one friendly Gnawhole wholly within 6" of the bearer and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. It cannot be set up within your opponent's deployment zone.

rules.name: First Claw Above
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

In a turn in which the bearer's unit emerged, add 1 to charge rolls made for that unit.

rules.name: Hoarder of Surface Spoils
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

Each time the bearer's unit emerges within range of an objective, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit until your next Command phase. If you gain control of that objective that turn, gain 1 Vermin.

rules.name: Grimoire of Thirteen Names
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO GREY SEER model only.

The bearer knows one spell of your choice from the Lore of the Hidden Fang.

rules.name: Bell-Ringer of the Final Hour
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO GREY SEER model only.

Once per battle round, when the bearer uses a spell through a Daemonic Conduit, it can Overcast that spell even if it has already Overcast this turn. After resolving that spell, the conduit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Thirteen-Eyed Familiar
rules.description:
Non-EPIC HERO GREY SEER model only.

Once per battle round, after the bearer makes a psychic roll, you can re-roll one of its dice.

rules.name: Captain
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

At the end of your Command phase, select one other friendly SKURVY unit within 6" of the bearer. You can transfer up to 2 Plunder from the bearer's unit to that unit, or from that unit to the bearer's unit.

rules.name: Master-at-Arms
rules.description:
SKURVY CHARACTER model only.

Add the following option to the Plunder Ledger for the bearer's unit: 3 Plunder - Bloody Boarding: Until the start of your next Command phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1 and those weapons have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Master Gunner
rules.description:
SKURVY CHARACTER model only.

Add the following option to the Plunder Ledger for the bearer's unit: 2 Plunder - Loaded for Bear: Until the start of your next Command phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [LETHAL HITS].

rules.name: Master Helmsman
rules.description:
SKURVY CHARACTER model only.

Add the following option to the Plunder Ledger for the bearer's unit: 3 Plunder - Hit-and-Run Rigging: Until the start of your next Command phase, after this unit has shot, if it is not engaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

rules.name: Black-Fur Boarders Upgrade
rules.description:
STORMVERMIN unit only.

This unit gains the SKURVY keyword. Add 1 to charge rolls made for this unit. Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Prize Gunnery Crews Upgrade
rules.description:
WEAPON TEAM unit only.

This unit gains the SKURVY keyword. While this unit has one or more Plunder Ledger options active, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Black-Flag Rigging Upgrade
rules.description:
SKAVEN VEHICLE or SKAVEN TRANSPORT unit only.

This unit gains the SKURVY keyword. Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. In your Movement phase, just after this unit ends an advance move, it can Plunder an objective within range as if it had ended a normal move. If it does, it cannot shoot or declare a charge this turn.

rules.name: Blacklord Supreme
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

After you declare battle formations, if the bearer is leading a STORMVERMIN unit, that unit begins the battle at Supremacy Rank 2 instead of Rank 1.

rules.name: Black-Iron Panoply
rules.description:
VERMINUS CHARACTER model only.

While the bearer is leading a STORMVERMIN unit that is at Supremacy Rank 2 or higher, each time an attack is allocated to a model in that unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Veterans of a Hundred Battles
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - STORMVERMIN unit only.

Once per battle round, when this unit fails a battle-shock roll, before reducing its Supremacy Rank, you can Sacrifice 1 model from this unit. If you do, do not reduce this unit's Supremacy Rank as a result of that failed roll. The battle-shock roll is still failed and all other consequences apply normally.

rules.name: Seer of Thirteen Omens
rules.description:
GREY SEER model only.

At the start of each battle round, when you generate new Prophecy dice, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one additional D6, then discard one of the dice just rolled.

rules.name: Warpstone Astrolabe
rules.description:
GREY SEER model only.

Once per battle round, when the bearer uses a Prophecy die, you can increase or decrease that die by 1, to a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 6, without spending Vermin. That Prophecy die cannot also be modified by Twist-Twist Fate!.

rules.name: Blood-Price Familiar
rules.description:
GREY SEER model only.

Once per battle round, when the bearer's unit would suffer mortal wounds as a result of using one or more Prophecy dice, you can Sacrifice one other friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY model within 6" of the bearer. If you do, the bearer's unit does not suffer those mortal wounds.

rules.name: Master of the Redline
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model only.

In your Command phase, select one friendly SKAVEN VEHICLE unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time that unit makes an Engine Strain roll, you can re-roll that roll.

rules.name: Warp-Fed Gearbox
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - SKAVEN VEHICLE unit only.

Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. Each time an advance roll is made for this unit, you can re-roll it.

rules.name: Jury-Rigged Stabilizers
rules.description:
UNIT ENHANCEMENT - SKAVEN VEHICLE unit only.

Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack in a turn in which this unit made an advance move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Hit roll.

rules.name: Great-Great Diplomat
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model whose unit has a Clan Allegiance only.

Once per phase, when a friendly unit with a different Clan Allegiance from the bearer's unit and within 6" of the bearer is selected to shoot or fight, select one enemy unit. For the purposes of Work-Work Together! For Now..., that enemy unit is treated as having already lost one or more wounds this phase as a result of attacks made by a friendly unit with the bearer's Clan Allegiance.

rules.name: Keeper of Everyone's Secrets
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model whose unit has a Clan Allegiance only.

Once per battle round, when a friendly unit with a different Clan Allegiance from the bearer's unit and within 8" of the bearer destroys an enemy unit, gain 1 Vermin.

rules.name: Contingency Bodyguards
rules.description:
SKAVEN CHARACTER model whose unit has a Clan Allegiance only.

Once per battle round, when the bearer's unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, select one friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit with a different Clan Allegiance within 3" of the bearer. You can Sacrifice D3 models from that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase subtract 1 from Wound rolls made against the bearer's unit.

rules.name: Jury-Rigged Warplock Optics
rules.description:
*BATTLELINE unit with one or more ranged weapons*

Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Scrap-Welded Armour
rules.description:
*BATTLELINE unit*

Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in this unit, improve that model's Save characteristic by 1 against that attack. Subtract 1" from this unit's Move characteristic.

rules.name: Shock-Collar Motivators
rules.description:
*BATTLELINE unit*

Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic. Each time this unit fails a battle-shock roll, you can re-roll that test. If that re-roll is also failed, this unit suffers D3 additional mortal wounds before resolving any other effects of that failed test.

rules.name: Gyroscopic Targeting Rig
rules.description:
*WEAPON TEAM unit*

Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [HEAVY]. Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack with a [HEAVY] weapon while this unit is benefiting from [HEAVY], re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Warp-Fed Drive
rules.description:
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit*

Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic. This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it made an advance move.

rules.name: Warpstone Stockpile
rules.description:
*Select one non-EPIC HERO SKRYRE CHARACTER model*

Once per battle, when a friendly SKRYRE unit within 6" of that model would resolve Warpstone Backlash, that model can expend the stockpile. If it does, ignore that instance of Warpstone Backlash. This does not prevent damage from other rules.

rules.name: Overstuffed Power Cells
rules.description:
*CLANRATS unit*

Change the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability of Warplock carbines equipped by models in this unit to [RAPID FIRE 2].

rules.name: Voltaic Shield Amplifiers
rules.description:
*WARPCLAD unit*

Improve this unit's invulnerable save by 1, to a maximum of 4+. At the end of any phase in which this unit made one or more invulnerable saving throws, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Overclocked Servomotors
rules.description:
*WARPCLAD unit*

Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 1 to advance and charge rolls made for it. After this unit makes an advance or charge move, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: More-More Barrels!
rules.description:
*WEAPON TEAM unit*

Each time this unit is selected to shoot, you can re-roll any or all dice used to determine the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Warpstone Supercharger
rules.description:
*WEAPON TEAM unit*

Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit. Those weapons have [HAZARDOUS].

rules.name: Unstable Power Regulators
rules.description:
*WEAPON TEAM unit*

Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1. After this unit has shot, roll one D6. On a 1-2, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Warp-Lightning Capacitors
rules.description:
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit*

After this unit ends a normal, advance or charge move, select one enemy unit within 6" and roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Emergency Warp-Shield
rules.description:
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit*

Once per battle, when this unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, this unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Reinforced-Ramshackle Hull
rules.description:
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit*

Add 1 to this unit's Toughness characteristic and subtract 1" from its Move characteristic.

rules.name: Hidden Workshop
rules.description:
*Unassigned Project*

After deployment, place one Hidden Workshop marker wholly within your deployment zone. While a friendly SKRYRE unit is within 6" of that marker, you can re-roll hazard rolls taken for that unit. If an enemy unit ends any kind of move within 3" of that marker, remove it from the battlefield.

rules.name: Warp-Blink Harnesses
rules.description:
*WARPCLAD unit*

Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit is not engaged, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it in the Under-Empire, even if it is not within range of a Gnawhole. Then roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. This does not require or use a Gnawhole.

rules.name: More-More Power!
rules.description:
*WEAPON TEAM unit*

Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit. After it has shot, this unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Meltdown Protocol
rules.description:
*WEAPON TEAM unit*

Once per battle, immediately after this unit has shot, it can shoot again. After it has shot for the second time, roll one D6: on a 1-2, this unit is destroyed; on a 3-5, this unit suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 6, nothing happens.

rules.name: Overloaded Warp Reactor
rules.description:
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit*

Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1; add 1 to fixed Attacks characteristics of those weapons; and each time a random Attacks characteristic is determined for one of those weapons, you can re-roll one of those dice. All ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [HAZARDOUS] until the end of the phase.

rules.name: More-More Engines!
rules.description:
*SKAVEN VEHICLE unit*

Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic and add 2 to advance rolls made for it. After this unit ends an advance move, roll one D6. On a 1, this unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Portable Gnawhole Generator
rules.description:
*Select one SKRYRE unit*

Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, if that unit is not engaged, place one friendly Gnawhole wholly within 3" of that unit and more than 8" horizontally from every enemy model. Then roll one D6. On a 1, remove that Gnawhole and the unit carrying the generator suffers D6 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Doomrocket Stockpile
rules.description:
*Select one non-EPIC HERO WARLOCK CHARACTER model*

That model is equipped with a Doomrocket: Range 48"; Attacks D6+6; BS 4+; S 10; AP -2; D 2; [BLAST 1, HAZARDOUS, INDIRECT FIRE, ONE SHOT, WARPSTONE].

rules.name: Big-Big Guns for Big-Big Rats!
rules.description:
*Select one STORMFIENDS unit*

That unit can purchase one Workshop Project from the Weapon Team Projects list as though it had the WEAPON TEAM keyword. It must be paid for normally, counts toward that unit's limit of 2 Workshop Projects, and does not otherwise grant the WEAPON TEAM keyword.

rules.name: Brass Orb
rules.description:
*Select one non-EPIC HERO SKRYRE CHARACTER model*

Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit within 12" and roll one D6: on a 1, the bearer suffers D6 mortal wounds; on a 2-3, the target suffers D3+3 mortal wounds; on a 4-5, the target suffers D3+6 mortal wounds and is battle-shocked; on a 6, the target suffers 13 mortal wounds and is battle-shocked. The Brass Orb is then expended.

rules.name: Doomsphere
rules.description:
*Grand Project, Unique*

After deployment, secretly select one objective in No Man's Land and record it. Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase during battle rounds 3-5, you can detonate it. Units within 3" suffer 2D6+3 mortal wounds; units more than 3" and within 6" suffer D6+3 mortal wounds; units more than 6" and within 13" suffer D3 mortal wounds. Every surviving unit within 6" is then battle-shocked. Until the start of your next Command phase, all models within range of that objective have OC 0. The objective remains on the battlefield.
